definitions.label: Reconstruction
definitions.scope: Postwar restoration, readmission, and political reorganization of the former Confederate states.
exclusion: incidental use of reconstruction in another sense

definitions.label: Citizenship
definitions.scope: National citizenship, legal status, naturalization, and incidents of citizenship.
exclusion: citizen used only as an address or honorific

definitions.label: Civil rights
definitions.scope: Equal civil or legal rights and their protection, including race-related rights.
exclusion: bare person or place mention without rights discussion

definitions.label: Voting rights
definitions.scope: Suffrage, franchise, voter qualifications, access to voting, and the right to vote.

definitions.label: Constitutional change
definitions.scope: Constitutional amendment, interpretation, or federal and state constitutional power when materially discussed.
exclusion: routine bill amendment mentioned without constitutional discussion

definitions.label: Taxation
definitions.scope: Tax policy, rates, collection, public revenue, and tax incidence.
exclusion: incidental tax label in an unrelated list

definitions.label: Military affairs
definitions.scope: Armed forces, military administration and service, and demobilization.
exclusion: passing veteran or person reference without military issue discussion

definitions.label: Congressional procedure
definitions.scope: Chamber rules, debate, motions, jurisdiction, and the legislative process.

definitions.label: Infrastructure
definitions.scope: Public works, transport, communications, and their construction or operation.
exclusion: place or route mentioned only as context

definitions.label: Public compensation
definitions.scope: Pay, allowances, and compensation for public officers or employees.
exclusion: name or title reference without compensation discussion
